_help: Code-review tooling config. Copy this to .claude/review-config.json (this repo only) OR ~/.agent-config-studio/review-gate/config.json (all your projects), then edit the values. The older ~/.claude/review-config.json is still read when the second file is absent. Env vars (REVIEW_REVIEWER, REVIEW_PICK, REVIEW_AUTHOR, ...) still override per run. The _help/_presets keys are ignored — delete them if you like. See your active settings with: node ~/.agent-config-studio/review-gate/review.mjs --show-config
_pool_help: Reviewers come from the `reviewer` role in ACS (Models → Roles), each family at its own flavor effort — not from this file. Each family's CLI follows its model id (claude- → claude, gpt- → codex, grok- → grok); families whose CLI is not installed are skipped, and the run says which. Adding a "reviewer" or "model" key pins one reviewer and bypasses the pool.
_pick_help: "first" = first family in the role's order; "rotate" = the family with the fewest reviews in the review log (tie → role order); a family name picks that family; the name of an optional local classifier command (one that answers the choice protocol) lets it choose from diff paths/stats and each family's flavor (confidence < 0.7 or a failure → first).
_classifier_help: Optional. The local classifier command a dispute may ask to choose its verifier. Empty: disputes go to another vendor first.
_crossFamily_help: "prefer" skips pool families from the author's vendor (codex | claude | grok) when another remains; "off" never filters. The author comes from REVIEW_AUTHOR or "author" (a family or vendor); unknown means no filtering.
_routing_help: Optional. Route reviews by diff size: the first entry whose maxLines the diff's changed lines are under picks the family; an entry with no maxLines takes the rest; a diff touching riskPaths is never small. A pick (REVIEW_PICK or "pick") or a force rule overrides it; with no routing the pick decides. Example: [{"maxLines": 150, "family": "<family>"}, {"family": "<family>"}].
_grokMcpAllow_help: Optional MCP server names from grok's own ~/.grok/config.toml that may start when grok reviews (grok runs with an empty temporary HOME, so nothing borrowed from ~/.claude or ~/.cursor starts; anything else that would start refuses grok). Their tools stay denied. ask-model reads the same key from the home config. A tracked repo config cannot set it.
_shadow_help: Optional families that review the same diff after the real review, detached, for comparison only: results go to review-log/shadow-log.jsonl and never affect findings, closes, the push gate or --summary. Reviews only. See --shadow-report. A tracked repo config cannot set it.
_pickShadow_help: Optional pickers that each log, in the background, which reviewer family they would have chosen for a review, how complex the diff is, and why: the name of your "classifier" command (asked on diff stats and paths only) and any family ask-model resolves (given the capped diff, asked with ask-model --min-tools from an empty temp folder: no tools for claude, the fewest each CLI allows for grok and codex; each record's tools and toolsNote say which). Data only: they never affect the reviewer, findings, closes or the push gate. Results go to review-log/shadow-log.jsonl as pick-shadow records; see --pick-report. Reviews only. A tracked repo config cannot set it.
_force_help: Hard rules applied before any pick, first match wins: {"paths": ["**/auth/**", "**/payments/**"], "family": "<family>"} fires when a changed file matches; {"paths": "risk", "family": "<family>"} fires on riskPaths. Globs are case-insensitive: ** spans directories, * and ? stay inside one; a pattern with no "/" matches any path segment, like .gitignore.
_verify_help: "off" (default): only the deterministic quote check. "second-opinion": every surviving HIGH/MEDIUM finding goes to one other pool family (another vendor when possible), which CONFIRMs or REFUTEs it; REFUTED findings move to a "disputed" section.
_claudeModel_help: Used when reviewer is "claude": "team" (default) runs the multi-agent team on the reviewer role's Claude families; a family or id runs one comprehensive agent on that model.
_codexHomes_help: Optional extra Codex home folders the agent guard installs into, besides ~/.codex and $CODEX_HOME.
_base_help: Leave "base" empty to auto-detect the remote's default branch (origin/HEAD) — correct in any repo. Only set it to pin a different base, e.g. "origin/develop".
_verifyCmd_help: Optional shell command run BEFORE the reviewer (e.g. "npm run type-check"). Pass or fail, its result is fed to the reviewer as context — it never blocks the review.
_fixCheck_help: "risk" (default): a fix after review that touches tests, verify scripts or riskPaths needs a fix check (--fix-check) before close. "always": any code fix after review needs one; docs, static, coverage-exempt and builds/ files never do, and a Grade's recheck counts as its check. The home config is the floor: a repo file, REVIEW_CONFIG or REVIEW_FIX_CHECK may raise it to "always", never lower it.
_coverageExempt_help: Path globs the push gate never asks coverage for, on top of the generated dependency lockfiles it exempts by default (package-lock.json, yarn.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum and the like, by exact name). The refusal and the summary name each exempt file as not reviewed. A tracked repo config cannot set it; use this home file, the environment (REVIEW_COVERAGE_EXEMPT) or an untracked repo file.
_coverageExemptDefaults_help: false turns the default lockfile exemptions off. A tracked repo config cannot set it.
_merge_help: Merge tier, report only (nothing merges, comments or labels): every --summary prints LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH with reasons and what this policy would do. policy: "off" (default, every tier needs a human) | "strict" (LOW merges only if every file is docs or tests) | "standard" (LOW merges) | "always" (LOW and MEDIUM merge; HIGH never). classifier: an optional local classifier command that may move only a MEDIUM to LOW at confidence >= threshold. alwaysHuman: globs that always make a change HIGH, on top of .github/workflows/** and package.json. A tracked repo config may only make the policy stricter and cannot set the classifier. merge.mjs (run once after the PR is open) acts on the policy and reads four more merge keys: onHuman ("comment", the default: label the PR needs-human and comment once | "none": write nothing), humanComment (the comment's first line; default "Needs human approval before merging."), requireChecks (default true: zero CI checks need a human; false allows zero checks, never a failing or pending one) and allowBehind (default false: a PR whose base moved needs a human). A tracked repo config may set onHuman, never humanComment, and may only set requireChecks to true and allowBehind to false.
